name: CountBadge
usage: Unread counts of conversations, to-do counts, team sizes, number of entries in a group

props.name: count
props.description: The count; nothing is shown when it is 0.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Tone: `accent` for unread items and to-dos that need attention; `neutral` for plain counts (members, child
items).

props.name: max
props.description: Counts above this value are shown as "max+".

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Neutral for plain counts, accent for unread and to-do items; hidden when the count is 0.
